title: REPORT on the protection of the European Union’s financial interests – combating fraud – annual report 2024
part_text: 23. Emphasises that public authorities have a crucial role in fostering a zero-tolerance culture against fraud, and stresses, in particular, the importance of fraud prevention to ensure that fraud, corruption, conflicts of interest, and other types of misuse of funds do not occur in the first place; stresses that sound and accountable public administration is a prerequisite for a credible zero-tolerance policy against fraud;
